exposure: colour code organization for emergency caesarean
Time period (before vs. after color code implementation)
Implementation of a color code organization for emergency cesarean
Emergency cesarean cases were categorized by color code: orange (urgent) and red (extremely urgent)
cohort: 220 patients who underwent emergency cesarean section at a secondary health care maternity
finding: Implementation of a color code organization for emergency cesarean section was associated with a trend towards reduced decision-to-birth delay and a lower rate of neonatal transfer.
